workarounds.symptom: Daytona extra allows daytona 2.0, which removes the 0.x API DaytonaSandboxClient uses
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: limit the Daytona extra to the supported 0.x SDK. Target files: pyproject.toml, uv.lock. This pull request fixes dependency resolution for `openai-agents[daytona]`. Daytona 2.0 moved the sandbox creation types that `DaytonaSandboxClient()` imports, causing construction to fail even when the extra was installed. The extra now requires `daytona>=0.226.1,<1`. The lockfile still selects 0.226.1. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/6065)

workarounds.symptom: `OpenAIConversationsSession.get_items()` and `pop_item()` return `async_` instead of the `async` wire field on function calls, so replayed or restored history sends an unknown parameter
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: preserve wire aliases when reading Conversations session history. Target files: src/agents/memory/openai_conversations_session.py, tests/memory/test_openai_conversations_session.py, tests/test_hitl_session_scenario.py. This pull request fixes `OpenAIConversationsSession.get_items()` and `pop_item()` returning `async_` for stored function calls. Both history queries now use the API field names, so callers can read and resubmit the `async` flag. Unset fields are still omitted. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/6047)

workarounds.symptom: After a RunState JSON round trip, the next nested handoff embeds the previous history summary instead of flattening it
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: flatten restored handoff history summaries. Target files: src/agents/handoffs/history.py, tests/test_extension_filters.py, tests/test_handoff_history_duplication.py. This pull request fixes nested handoffs after a run resumes from a JSON checkpoint. The handoff reader recognizes the single text part that `RunState` writes for a generated summary. Assistant messages with provider metadata retain their original structure. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/6041)

workarounds.symptom: Already-completed sibling output guardrail result omitted from tripwire `run_data.output_guardrail_results` when the tripping result is consumed first (output counterpart of #5567)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: report completed output guardrails when a tripwire fires. Target files: src/agents/run_internal/guardrails.py, tests/test_guardrails.py. This pull request fixes missing output guardrail results when the runner consumes a tripwire before a sibling whose result is already available. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/6040)

workarounds.symptom: Agent end hooks lose the structured purchase details of an agent-as-tool call
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: preserve structured tool input in agent lifecycle hooks. Target files: src/agents/run_internal/run_loop.py, src/agents/run_internal/turn_resolution.py, tests/test_agent_as_tool.py. This pull request fixes agent start and end hooks receiving `None` for `context.tool_input` when a nested `Agent.as_tool()` run has structured arguments. Both streaming and non-streaming hooks now receive the current run's parsed input. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/6037)

workarounds.symptom: Runner.run_streamed sends a model request after a parallel input guardrail has already tripped
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: skip streamed model attempts after an input guardrail trips. Target files: src/agents/run_internal/model_retry.py, src/agents/run_internal/run_loop.py, tests/test_stream_input_guardrail_timing.py. This pull request fixes a case where `Runner.run_streamed` could send a model request after a parallel input guardrail had already rejected the input. The runner now checks the recorded verdict immediately before opening each model stream, including retries. Pending guardrails still allow parallel execution, and er... (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/5644)

workarounds.symptom: An approved tool's guardrail results are dropped when the resumed run continues to the next turn
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: retain tool guardrail results after approval and resume. Target files: src/agents/run.py, src/agents/run_internal/run_loop.py, tests/test_agent_runner.py. This pull request fixes the loss of tool guardrail results when an approved tool finishes and the runner calls the model again. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/5643)

workarounds.symptom: Default tool error text tells the model to "try again" after a call that may already have taken effect
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: remove retry advice from the default tool error message. Target files: src/agents/tool.py, tests/mcp/test_mcp_util.py, tests/sandbox/capabilities/test_tool_input_errors.py. This pull request removes "Please try again." from the default tool error message. A tool can raise after a write succeeds, and the SDK cannot determine whether repeating the call is safe. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/5632)
